summary:
Each fact java declares is true of its runtime. I found no false sentence on the four pages I read, and every java code block in the 19 variations that have java compiles. I ran them on OLD and NEW: NEW 351/351 and OLD 333/333, compiled with javac against a full SDK generated for each variation. The tutorial was compiled as one program with only the imports it prints. Under the test constructor, OLD and NEW fail in the same ways (mock 404s, and fetch_mode_block in no-test). Run from the repository root in jshell, every root quick start, OLD and NEW, gets as far as the live request. The reviewed one command passes again with the porter's exact numbers, and the scratch run gives the porter's exact numbers.

But the port breaks the repository's own suite, which the porter did not run. Ran from scratch: 2635 tests, 2627 pass, 3 fail. All three are java tests in test/generate.test.ts, and all three pass at v33-frozen (4/4 with the same pattern) and fail on the port (1/4):
- Syntax_java.ts holds a second example-literal table (lines 70-72, a copy of utility_java.ts javaLit).
- It writes a null-only member into Map.of, e.g. `client.tally(null).list(Map.of("z", null), null)` and `load(Map.of("id", "example_id", "z", null), null)`. Map.of throws NullPointerException on a null value (ran in jshell). The old components left such members out.
None of the 21 variations has a null-only member, so the one command, the tools and the lane (structure only) cannot see this.

What I attacked:
- 26 single-change attacks against the guard. It names 18. One more (a wrong ctorAlts kind) fails the build.
- The other 7 pass the guard, and with the one command each fails only as open, absent or stale classes, which a porter decides by hand:
  - `none: 'this'`, a token that stands in the cited quote;
  - a bogus cast in `deleted`;
  - `arity` removed, so the page names `list()`;
  - `static` dropped from a test signature;
  - a `throws` marker added;
  - an accessor called on the type, `DemoSDK.planet(null)`, which javac rejects;
  - a wrong result cast;
  - also a wrong cast written into the pages.
- Every enumerated, language and convention change and every dropped shared sentence fails by name.

Weaker than OLD:
- OLD's "(as `Object`)" is gone (porter's gap 1). It is real for kotlin, scala and csharp too.
- `((EntityBase) result).deleted()` compiles only with `import voxgig.demosdk.entity.EntityBase`, which no page states. The deleted template fills only {var}.
- The stream-signal sentence does not say that only a BooleanSupplier counts.

Runtime defects (not the port):
- The java mock drops created records when its seed has none for the entity (TestFeature.java:228-231). This explains the update-after-create 404.
- The accessor writes `active` into the caller's map, so passing `Map.of(...)` as entopts throws UnsupportedOperationException (ran).
